subject.title: [Feature]: Control UI should show compact run progress for long or multi-agent tasks

question: Which gateway/session activity contract should become the canonical source for the compact Control UI run-progress surface?
rationale: The requested UI needs state beyond current `status` and `hasActiveRun`, and open related issues/PRs propose different API and presentation boundaries that automation should not choose unilaterally.

options.title: Canonicalize session activity first
options.body: Use the broader session activity API/statechange design as the source of truth, then build the compact Control UI strip on top of it.

options.title: Narrow an existing PR
options.body: Adopt one open implementation candidate only after trimming it to the agreed API/UX boundary and satisfying proof and merge-risk requirements.

options.title: Defer UI progress
options.body: Keep the current coarse status UI until maintainers are ready to own the broader session activity semantics.

recommendation.title: Canonicalize session activity first
recommendation.body: Use the broader session activity API/statechange design as the source of truth, then build the compact Control UI strip on top of it.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows the broadest overlap across the Control UI and gateway/session lifecycle surfaces involved in this decision.
